sources: https://thedyrt.com/camping/montana/prickly-pear-fishing-access-site and https://www.campendium.com/prickly-pear (reviews, via web search summaries; aggregators, used only for the flag)

values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753714 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753714 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet (type not stated) and a primitive campsite; no drinking water listed. ADA accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753714 (Facilities: 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (0.1 acre, ~3,820 ft) on Little Prickly Pear Creek with designated primitive camping, beside I-15. Directions (FWP): take Wolf Creek Exit 226 off I-15, then 7 miles south on Recreation Rd. FWP: 'Very tight spot. Walk downhill to access creek.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, toilet, primitive campsite; added the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: trailer length, site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees; FWP's 'Very tight spot' caveat added.
flags: Criteria problem (rig fit): FWP publishes no trailer length but describes the 0.1-acre site as 'Very tight spot. Walk downhill to access creek.' Reviewers (The Dyrt, Campendium; newest found 2024) describe a single campsite with a steep hill in and little room to turn around and advise against RVs; no review reports a rig of 23 ft or more fitting. Agency vague + no confirming review -> may not fit a 23-ft motorhome.
Missing phone: FWP Region 4 Headquarters (Great Falls) 406-454-5840 (https://fwp.mt.gov/aboutfwp/regions/region4); the FishMT page's Contact Information section is empty.
